title: Holdlook
description: Simpe mod that changes you from first to third person with a hold or toggle.
body:
![Holdlook](https://i.imgur.com/RNLAaoG.png)
We all know the Perspective mod was banned, so Lunar and Badlion Client created their own 'perspective' Esque mod respectively. Without the rule breaker advantage of a 360° view with bed lock. Well, I got annoyed that there was no public version of the mod, so I made it myself. It currently just has the option to hold to snap to F5 views, I might add a toggle function if enough people use the mod and request it.


**Holdlook**

Simple mod that changes you from first to third person with a hold or toggle.

I made this mod years ago when Hypixel blacklisted the perspective mod, and Lunar Client and BadLion didn't have their 'Snaplook' type mod public, so I just made it myself...

|Default Keybind | Description |
|---|-----------------|
| **None** | Hold Back View (Over Shoulder) |
| **None** | Hold Front View |
| **None** | Toggle Back View |
| **None** | Toggle Front View |

_Keybinds can be changed in settings_

Code is open-source, with credit given. refer to [License](https://github.com/Cats1337/holdlook/blob/main/LICENSE).
